heroHeadline: EU Marks Ukraine's 35th Independence Day With €6.1B Air Defense Package
heroSubtitle: On August 24, the European Commission illuminated the Berlaymont in Ukrainian colors and approved €6.1 billion in fresh air and missile defense funding, taking cumulative EU support to Ukraine since 2022 to €220.2 billion; European Council President Costa and other leaders traveled to Kyiv for the ceremony. Days earlier, the EU Civil Protection Mechanism mobilized rescEU aircraft and firefighters from Sweden, the Netherlands, Norway, Germany and France to help Belgium and Spain battle major wildfires, including Belgium's largest blaze on record. On the economic front, Eurostat confirmed Eurozone GDP grew +0.4% q/q in Q2 (rebounding from a flat Q1), HICP inflation eased to 2.9% in July after May's 3.2% cycle high, and the ECB held its deposit rate at 2.25% on July 23 after June's hike. The EU-US trade deal's implementing legislation cleared the European Parliament plenary June 16 but still awaits ratification by all 27 member states.
footerNote: Data sourced from official EU institutions (EUR-Lex, European Commission, ECB, Eurostat, European Council), major outlets, and institutional analyses.
